This page lists the people credited for [[Matcha Flavoured]], as given in the README, the datapack's <code>CREDITS.txt</code> and the release notes.<ref>{{Source|README.md}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/CREDITS.txt}}</ref> The pack's design, code and textures are by '''Klei Wright''' unless noted.

== Contributors ==
=== Music ===
* '''Ciren''': the music disc "Golden", added in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.0|1.0]] in memory of the developer's dog, Dakota.
* '''DeBlezyBestie''': the music discs "Malachite", "Crete" and "Elegy of The Abbey".
* '''Vee Vaicekauskas''': the background tracks "Refuge", "Abbey", "Ruby", "Through Hell" and "Estus".
See [[Music]].

=== Art ===
* '''imtlx''': fishing sounds and the [[Angler's Almanac]].
* '''Movpasd''': the gradated biome and foliage color maps.
* '''Voxybuns''': custom effect and intrinsic icons.
* '''Pepurion''': rose models.
* '''Zergologist''': the original lapis lazuli textures.
* '''roliuu''': Axiom and Easy Shulkers interface textures.
* '''MrHatsy''': chiseled sandstone texture.
* '''LambS0up''': purple Nether portal texture.
* '''IrrelevantGaymer''': brick, bed and sandstone texture work after 1.12.2.<ref>{{Source|changelog.md}}</ref>

=== Code ===
* '''Linkershim''': optimizations, multiplayer support and other code.
* '''Hashiru''': optimizations, including non-ticking armor, particles, warding stones and crystal hearts.
* '''HapppySpud''': removing gravel from Hell, keeping enchantments when smithing, random asylum seekers, hellspore generation, and several fixes.
* '''FloofShade''': the item update trigger. See [[Updating items]].
* '''Pepurion''': optimizations and many bug fixes.
* '''ReinIsNOTaDev''': optimizations, the GitHub workflow and the timeline-based day length.
* '''Fpekal''': bug fixes, optimizations and the 26.3 port.
* '''milo256''': dynamic multiplayer sleep.
* '''NamelessJu''': code suggestions, Modrinth issues and translation.
* '''Fayranchia''', '''EastMonster''', '''Tralomine''', '''TankyAibem''' and '''CubertCuberton''': bug fixes and suggestions.
* '''Bingbongbooper''': food ideas.

=== Translation ===
The translation project is led by '''Natroute''', with the spreadsheet compiled into JSON by '''imtlx'''. The README credits: Zevran, Ithlil and Alaska (French); Pepurion (Russian); Fellter_CZ and Exmori (Czech); NamelessJu, Flix8 and Koguri3108 (German); Flix8 (Swiss German); Seba (Chilean Spanish); Joxer021 (Spanish); Phonem (Turkish); deneben (Canadian English); Vee (British English); EastMonster (Simplified Chinese); Knoctis and Sego_dk (Danish); imtlx and malberee (Ukrainian); Briefle and Yassin (Italian); Kuzuyukii (Polish); HapppySpud and imtlx (joke English variants).

== Inspirations ==
The credits stress that none of the following people know of or endorse the pack.
* '''Raspmary''', whose modpack ''Raspberry Flavoured'' inspired the pack, including electrum, shakudo, hepatizon and divine fragments.
* '''JermsyBoy''', whose resource pack ''A Little Taste of Jerm'' the textures were first based on and later redrawn to resemble.
* '''MiziraGamez''', for the framework for endless repairing.
* '''Gooporeal''', for the lichen models.
* '''Vectorwing''', for inspiring many textures.
* '''Rhythmic''' (PurpurMC), for the framework for looting shears.
